name: Dielectric Lightning
desc: A Lichtenberg discharge tree that branches out of a seed toward biased-random points, freshest tips flaring electric-blue before fading to etched veins as bolts re-strike each section, rendered as blue-white plasma, amber acrylic Lichtenberg, cyan wiring schematic, red neural discharge, or false-color thermal.

density.doc: attractor cloud + node cap (610..1600) = branch mass filling the frame

energy.doc: fresh-tip flare glow + strike bloom amplitude

speed.doc: growth iterations per frame (discharge propagation rate)

branch.doc: branchiness: low=long straight whip bolts, high=bushy fine Lichtenberg fractal

scale.doc: segment step / channel size (chunkier vs finer filaments)

strike.doc: re-strike bolt frequency (0=silent creep only, 1=frequent flashes)

style.doc: render philosophy: blue-white plasma / amber acrylic Lichtenberg / cyan wiring diagram / red neural discharge / false-color thermal heat ramp

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg, lower=translucent overlay)
